title: Implement prime number utilities in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement sieve_of_eratosthenes, prime_factorization, and is_prime.

injections.content:
from src.primes import sieve_of_eratosthenes, prime_factorization, is_prime


def test_sieve_basic():
    assert sieve_of_eratosthenes(10) == [2, 3, 5, 7]
    assert sieve_of_eratosthenes(2) == [2]
    assert sieve_of_eratosthenes(1) == []


def test_is_prime():
    assert is_prime(2)
    assert is_prime(13)
    assert not is_prime(1)
    assert not is_prime(15)
    assert not is_prime(0)


def test_prime_factorization_basic():
    assert prime_factorization(12) == [2, 2, 3]
    assert prime_factorization(30) == [2, 3, 5]
    assert prime_factorization(7) == [7]


def test_prime_factorization_power_of_two():
    assert prime_factorization(8) == [2, 2, 2]


def test_sieve_primes_correct():
    primes = sieve_of_eratosthenes(50)
    for p in primes:
        assert is_prime(p)
    assert all(not is_prime(n) for n in range(2, 51) if n not in primes)
